notes: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (FY2026 Form 20-F on sec.gov). IFRS, USD (the Indian annual report uses INR). Income taxes paid sit in operating. 'Interest and dividend received' (98) sit in investing, so OCF is not inflated by them. No cash interest-paid line exists, so interestPaid is null; the accrued lease finance cost (41), settled through financing lease payments, is recorded as context and not added. Taxes paid (973) are net of 408 of refunds for earlier years received in fiscal 2026 (not adjusted). The 20-F's new-year XBRL facts are not in companyfacts, so no xbrl objects are given.
